From HoTT Require Import Basics Types ReflectiveSubuniverse Modality Pointed.Core Pointed.pMap.
(** * Modalities, reflective subuniverses and pointed types *)

#[export] Instance ispointed_O `{O : ReflectiveSubuniverse} (X : Type)
  `{IsPointed X} : IsPointed (O X) := to O _ (point X).

Definition pto (O : ReflectiveSubuniverse@{u}) (X : pType@{u})
  : X ->* [O X, _]
  := Build_pMap (to O X) idpath.
(** If [A] is already [O]-local, then Coq knows that [pto] is an equivalence, so we can simply define: *)

Definition pequiv_pto `{O : ReflectiveSubuniverse} {X : pType} `{In O X}
  : X <~>* [O X, _] := Build_pEquiv (pto O X) _.
(** Applying [O_rec] to a pointed map yields a pointed map. *)

goals.conclusion: pO_rec f o* pto O X ==* f
pO_rec f o* pto O X ==* f
pO_rec f o* pto O X == f
?p pt = dpoint_eq (pO_rec f o* pto O X) @ (dpoint_eq f)^
O_rec_beta f pt = dpoint_eq (pO_rec f o* pto O X) @ (dpoint_eq f)^
O_rec_beta f pt = (1 @ (O_rec_beta f pt @ point_eq f)) @ (dpoint_eq f)^
O_rec_beta f pt @ dpoint_eq f = 1 @ (O_rec_beta f pt @ point_eq f)

contents: (** A pointed version of the induction principle for a modality. *)

Definition pO_ind `{O : Modality} {X : pType} {Y : pFam [O X, _]}
 `{forall x, In O (Y x)} (f : pForall X (pfam_precompose Y (pto O X)))
  : pForall [O X, _] Y
  := Build_pForall _ Y (O_ind Y f) (O_ind_beta Y f pt @ dpoint_eq f).

goals.conclusion: functor_pforall_left (pO_ind f) (pto O X) ==* f

contents: (* [reflexivity] works here, but then the underlying map won't agree definitionally with precomposition by [pto P], since pointed composition inserts a reflexivity path here. *)

goals.conclusion: IsEquiv (Build_pMap (fun f : [O P, ispointed_O P] ->** Q => f o* pto O P) 1)

hypotheses.body:
issig_pmap P Q
oE equiv_functor_sigma' (equiv_o_to_O O P Q)
     (fun f : [O P, ispointed_O P] -> Q =>
      equiv_concat_l 1 pt
      :
      (fun f0 : [O P, ispointed_O P] -> Q => f0 pt = pt) f <~>
      (fun f0 : P -> Q => f0 pt = pt) (equiv_o_to_O O P Q f))
oE (issig_pmap [O P, ispointed_O P] Q)^-1

Note that it does not subsume [pequiv_o_pto_O], since [to O X] is only known to be [O]-connected when [O] is a modality. *)

contents: (* This is the path that pointed composition inserts, so the underlying map agrees definitionally with precomposition by [f]. *)

goals.conclusion:
IsEquiv
  (Build_pMap (fun g : B ->** Y => g o* f)
     (path_pforall (postcompose_pconst f)))

hypotheses.body:
issig_pmap A Y
oE equiv_functor_sigma' (equiv_o_conn_map O f (fun _ : B => Y))
     (fun g : B -> Y =>
      equiv_concat_l (ap g (point_eq f)) pt
      :
      (fun f0 : B -> Y => f0 pt = pt) g <~>
      (fun f0 : A -> Y => f0 pt = pt)
        (equiv_o_conn_map O f (fun _ : B => Y) g))
oE (issig_pmap B Y)^-1
